scientific_integrity: The proof has a symbolic resolvent identity, a path-size monotonicity lemma, exact positive Bernstein certificates at n=32, and a rational negative witness at n=33. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified endpoint-neighbor transition of the unweighted Neumann path is classified, not all entries or individual stages. An older directly relevant one-dimensional composite PDE paper by Carroll (1993) was identified but not inspected in full; possible previously published equivalent results remain a priority risk.
title: Thirty-three vertices mark the first endpoint-neighbor sign loss for TR-BDF2 diffusion on paths
